description: Lists the active projects in the user's organization. FREE — database only, charges no credits. Use this whenever you need a `projectId` for another MisarSEO tool. Returns `{id, name, domain, url}` per project; pass the `id` value as `projectId`. `domain` is null for a project that has never had one set, which is not a missing lookup — get_keyword_gap and get_link_intersect read the project's own domain from this record and refuse to run without it. Archived projects are not listed.
name: list_projects
